uslaw-usc-t2-s1881d: Section 1881d of Title 2 of the United States Code sets the date on which a set of rules takes force. It sits in Chapter 28, on the Architect of the Capitol. Its part deals with Capitol-flown flags for the kin of fallen heroes. The subchapter is to take force on 16 May 2016. One bar is set on that date. No such flag may be given under a named section till a set of rules made under a second section takes force.
